name: AUSTRIA
source: Open Hymnal Project ABC score and the score on Wikipedia's article, which agree on every note and on the underlay.
reviewNotes: The sources differ only in the rhythm of bar 12 ('sure re-pose'): this follows Wikipedia's B. B C (dotted crotchet, quaver, minim); the Open Hymnal has B B C C with 're-' over two quavers. The B natural is the sharpened fah (fe).
